replacements.De o1 a los modelos actuales: arquitectu: From o1 to today's models: architectures, openness and comparative performance.
replacements.De la cadena de pensamiento privada al e: From private chain of thought to open training — in less than a year.
replacements.Primer modelo con cadena de pensamiento: First model with an autonomous internal chain of thought. CoT hidden from the user. Trained with RL on mathematical reasoning and code.
replacements.Primer modelo razonador open-source de n: First frontier-level open-source reasoning model. Trained with GRPO (without a separate critic model). Public, readable CoT. 671B parameters.
replacements.Modo híbrido: razonamiento estándar o ex: Hybrid mode: standard or extended reasoning in the same model. CoT visible and readable by design. Configurable thinking-token budget.
replacements.Mayor ventana de contexto nativa (1M tok: Largest native context window (1M tokens). Reasoning integrated with multimodal capabilities. Thinking configurable from the API.
replacements.Razonamiento profundo con búsqueda inter: Deep reasoning with extended internal search. Maximum accuracy in mathematics and code. Very high cost and latency at maximum effort.
replacements.Los modelos razonadores difieren en qué: Reasoning models differ in which parts of the process they expose — with different implications for auditing, safety and trust.
replacements.La CoT visible no garantiza fidelidad al: Visible CoT does not guarantee faithfulness to the internal process — but it does enable external auditing and detection of failure patterns.
replacements.Rendimiento comparativo en los tres benc: Comparative performance on the three most informative benchmarks for complex reasoning. September 2025 figures (pass@1 unless stated).
